title: Bob Beckwith, Philadelphia Experiment and teleportation

tellings.quote: Yes. Does he say cuz he claims that I think he was maybe somewhat involved in the Philadelphia experiment and then he later did some really interesting work with like extremely high magnetic fields and and then and teleportation.

plain: A man named Robert Beckwith is said to have had some part in the Philadelphia Experiment, a rumoured wartime US Navy experiment said to have made a ship vanish, and to have later worked with extremely strong magnetic fields and on teleportation. Michels raises this, hedging that Beckwith "claims" it and was "maybe somewhat involved", while asking a guest named Dave Rossi about him; if true, it would tie the old Navy legend to real later research.
